description: This file is an Android activity class 'MainActivity' that handles user device credential authentication, key management with Android Keystore, encryption attempts, and UI interactions for a secure purchase flow.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main entry point for the sample application, managing device credential authentication, cryptographic key creation, and UI updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, checks device security, creates cryptographic keys, sets up button click listener.

methods.name: tryEncrypt
methods.description: Attempts to encrypt data with the stored key; triggers user authentication if necessary.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Generates a symmetric encryption key in Android Keystore that requires user authentication for use.

methods.name: showAuthenticationScreen
methods.description: Starts the device credential confirmation activity to authenticate the user.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the device credentials authentication activity.

methods.name: showPurchaseConfirmation
methods.description: Displays confirmation message after successful encryption.

methods.name: showAlreadyAuthenticated
methods.description: Displays message indicating recent successful device credential authentication.
